summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Glaucus of Corinth, Glaucus the sea-god's human namesakes, and the many other Glaucuses in Greek epic.

story.text: Apollodorus names Glaucus among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Argius and before Calydoneus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
